hypothesis: ADR-0006 F9: on each pinned fleet, the planner (plan_job, SCHEDULER task 4, I16 as written with epsilon 3%, k counted, R10/R13 deferred) chooses the plan pinned here, whose expected step time the SCHEDULER-I17 oracle (SC-4) derives with the planner's own attention-inclusive costs (partition.layer_costs for the cut, zero_bubble.analytic_costs with recompute for F/B/W), names every refused candidate with its link, number, class or MEM-HOST, and never chooses a plan whose simulated step is more than 1% above the best admitted candidate's.

costModel.label: every input HYPOTHESIS (rounds 3-5); every output DERIVED
costModel.exchange: SCHEDULER-I17 oracle (docs/experiments/m2b-e4/derive/i17_oracle.py): per-(sender, destination) need-first queues, 16 MiB chunks, egress and ingress at min(NIC, PCIe), host DRAM at k passes per side, uplinks, max-min fair; gathers after the owner's last fold and AdamW; E and window_s from one simulation of every microbatch
costModel.step: period + max_s max(0, E_s - window_s) + T_ovh (+ the uplink floor where a hop crosses it)
costModel.hop_comm: one boundary tensor at the link rate + RTT/2 per hop (SPEC section 2.1); 0 in the granted derivation (sensitivity comm0: no choice moves)
costModel.candidates: width 1 at the deepest cut; for w in 2, 4, 8 the deepest cut on N/w devices with pieces + native, zero1 + native, zero1 + fp32 (SCHEDULER task 4)
costModel.zero1_ownership: stride over the parameter list, whole tensors (tok on peer 0, pos on peer 1)
costModel.mem_host: charged on pieces only (SCHEDULER-I16; task 4: zero1 keeps today's admission, device memory); the class rule on every wide candidate, as granted
costModel.lane_solve: lane_solve.py: the SPEC's zero-bubble rules as a list scheduler, independent of src/wantrain; it attains the closed-form lower bound P* on every lane and equals the as-built lane periods exactly (e7_spec.out, lanes section)

amendments.reason: The granted derivation (e7.py on round 4's exch4) priced host DRAM only in S1 and a busiest-host bound, and let a hot owner's gathers overlap its ingress. SCHEDULER-I17, the SPEC of record, shares each host's DRAM at k passes per side inside the exchange simulation and releases a unit's gathers after the owner's last fold and AdamW; S2 and the step read E from that one simulation. Re-derived by an independent oracle written from the SPEC text, on the candidate set of SCHEDULER task 4 (the 128-GPU fleets gain S 32 w 2) with the SPEC's per-hop comm, and with MEM-HOST charged on pieces only as the SPEC states it (open question 5 settled). The lane solve is independent of src/wantrain (lane_solve.py) and equals the as-built lane periods on every candidate. Changed choices: 32xH100-400G-1gph-k10, 32xH100-400G-2gph-k10, 32xH100-2sites-10G-uplink, 32xH100-400G-1gph-k10-memhost20.
